title: Sick Leave Act 2022
verified_how: Act number found in the eISB 2022 listing. Enacted page title: 'Sick Leave Act 2022'. The directory entry shows ss. 1-3 commenced 29 Nov 2022 and s. 4 and the remaining provisions 1 Jan 2023 (S.I. No. 606 of 2022).
notes: Statutory sick pay. The number of days is set by ministerial order.
